note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A cleaning completion is not a safe-to-occupy certificate. Clearance is for a qualified or independent party.
The Victorian guidance places the clearance with an independent person, and the barricades stay until then.

practicalCriteria: The learner reports only completed work and names the limits that remain.
The learner refuses any safe-to-occupy or contamination-free statement.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: A safe-to-occupy or contamination-free statement is requested.
Barricades are to be removed before the independent clearance.
